# NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS)

> > The Astrophysics Data System is NASA's digital library for astronomy, astrophysics, planetary science, and earth science research literature, operated by the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory at Harvard.

ADS provides access to millions of scholarly articles, preprints, and citations with advanced search capabilities, personal libraries, and a developer API. The platform has evolved from ADS Classic to the modern Bumblebee interface and now includes Science Explorer (SciX) for broader scientific discovery.

## Getting Started

- [Astrophysics Data System Homepage](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu): Main entry point for searching NASA's digital library of astronomy and physics literature
- [About ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/about): Overview of ADS mission, operated by SAO for NASA scientific community
- [Classic Search Form](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/classic-form): Classic search form interface for ADS database queries
- [ADS Help](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help): Main help hub with documentation, tutorials, and support contact info
- [FAQ](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/faq): Frequently asked questions covering search, ORCID, and data curation

## User Guides & Documentation

- [ADS Libraries](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/libraries): Guide to creating and managing ADS Libraries for organizing records
- [Library Example: Martha Shapley](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/libraries/library-example-martha-shapley): Library example featuring Martha Shapley's work on eclipsing binaries
- [Data & Curation FAQ](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/data_faq/data-faq): FAQs on article submission, arXiv ingestion, and metadata corrections
- [Data Curation Guidelines](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/data_faq): Data curation FAQ with submission guidelines and update schedules

## Developer Resources

- [ADS API Documentation](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/api): Developer API documentation with tokens, notebooks, and code examples

## About & Community

- [ADS Team](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/about/team): Complete ADS staff directory with roles and contact information
- [ADS History](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/about/history): Evolution of ADS from 1980s to modern Bumblebee interface
- [ADS Users Group (ADSUG)](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/about/adsug): ADS Users Group advisory committee information and membership
- [ADS Blog](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/blog): Blog with SciX launch announcements and community updates
- [Careers at ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/about/careers): Job openings and career opportunities at ADS/SAO in Cambridge, MA

## Example Research Articles

- [Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis Revisited](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1973ApJ...179..343W/abstract): Wagoner's Astrophysical Journal paper on primordial nucleosynthesis
- [The Fractal Geometry of Nature](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1983whf..book.....M/abstract): Mandelbrot's classic book on fractal geometry indexed in ADS
- [Optical Tweezers Tutorial](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AdOP...13...74G/abstract): Comprehensive optical tweezers tutorial with sample data and software
- [Partial Least-Squares Regression Tutorial](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1986AcAC..185....1G): Geladi & Kowalski's PLS regression tutorial in Analytica Chimica Acta
- [Artificial Neural Networks for Beginners](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2003cs........8031G/abstract): Gershenson's beginner guide to ANNs and backpropagation algorithm
- [X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Guide](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022JAP...132a1101G/abstract): Comprehensive XPS tutorial from experimental setup to analysis
- [Superconducting Quantum Circuits Tutorial](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026BrJPh..56...56C/abstract): Undergraduate-level tutorial on superconducting quantum circuits and cQED
- [Magnetohydrodynamic Shocks](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1952AJ.....57R..12H/abstract): Astronomical Journal article by Helfer on magnetohydrodynamic shocks
